titulo: ‘We will not be intimidated,’ says Estonian PM after attributing recent arson attack to Russia - Europe live
cuerpo: Kristen Michal says attack ‘against Milrem Robotics was ordered by Russian special services’, after Kremlin denies involvement Rutte begins by recalling a drone shot down in Lithuanian airspace by Nato fighter jets two weeks ago. He says “the repeated drone incidents along our eastern flank showed the evolving nature of the threat, and we are strengthening our integrated air and missile defence.” “We are adapting and reinforcing our posture against drones.” Continue reading...
